description: Defines the RecruitmentAttachment Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used in the recruitment plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates properties related to a recruitment attachment, such as ID, filename, file type, size, associated identity, and comment, with constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachment
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for recruitment attachments, storing file info and related metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a RecruitmentAttachment object with its properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getFkIdentity
methods.description: Returns the foreign key identity associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.
